body:
_Migrated from issue #885, filed 2026-07-13._

**Summary (internal tech-debt):** metadata/cover providers use inconsistent per-request HTTP timeouts. Most providers use `timeout=15`; Amazon uses `timeout=10` per page-fetch with a ~15s pool cap; the cover-picker pool default is ~12s (`cps/metadata_provider/cover_picker.py`). There is no single shared timeout constant, so a slow provider can stretch the synchronous metadata-search / cover-picker window.

**No user-visible hang observed** — this is a maintainability/consistency issue, not a live bug.

**Candidate (low priority):** centralize a provider HTTP-timeout constant and document the pool-vs-per-request budget so the synchronous window is predictable across providers.

_Filed from the internal metadata-provider audit (org run 2026-07-13). Low priority._
title: Centralize metadata-provider HTTP timeout budget (consistency)
